title: fix(mobile): the native bridge platform is an open set, and a newer bridge protocol reads as no bridge
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbGJyQF5yrTTG9tojdS1NGJy)_

Fixes #29330

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:原生壳桥的 `platform` 类型从 `ios | android` 放开为开放集合(桌面壳可报其它值);新增桥协议版本门:壳报的 `version` 大于 1 或不是数字时,Console 当作没有壳、走浏览器路径;写明 `ready` 的含义;README 示例去掉按壳切换文案的分支。
- **为什么改**:桌面壳即将上线且报 `desktop`,旧的封闭类型会让消费方写出漏掉它的穷举分支;`version` 从未被读,将来协议破坏性升级时旧 Console 会误调新协议;壳将依赖 `ready` 揭开加载遮罩(mobile#162),需要明确它在鉴权加载态就会发出。
- **风险与回滚**:运行时只多一道版本判断,现有壳都报版本 1,行为不变;类型放宽只可能让对 `platform` 做穷举 switch 的代码编译不过,全仓只有 Console 一处把它原样写进属性。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/mobile/src/nativeHost.ts`(`getNativeHost` 的版本门与 `platform` 类型)→ `ui/apps/console/src/__tests__/App.nativeShellOpenSet-29330.test.tsx` → `ui/apps/console/src/__tests__/main.nativeBridgeVersion-29330.test.tsx`。
- **两分钟验证**:在 `ui/` 下跑 `pnpm exec vitest run apps/console/src/__tests__/App.nativeShellOpenSet-29330.test.tsx`,预期 4 个用例全绿(桌面壳、鉴权加载态时的 ready、版本 2 不进壳模式及其对照)。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`ObjectStackNative.platform` is an open set.** The type widens from `'ios' | 'android'` to `'ios' | 'android' | (string & {})`, so the two known values still autocomplete and the desktop shell's value type-checks. The runtime already treated it as open: `getNativeHost` never checked it, the Console writes it verbatim into `data-os-native-shell`, and the call wrappers gate on `has()` only. The README and the pending `.changeset/29039-mobile-native-shell-mode.md` now say the attribute carries the shell's platform string, an open set.
- **Bridge protocol version gate.** The bridge type says `version` "bumps only on a breaking change". `nativeHost.ts` gains `NATIVE_BRIDGE_VERSION = 1` (module export used by the tests; not added to the package entry, which this PR leaves untouched). `getNativeHost()` answers `null` for a host whose `version` is not a number (NaN included) or is greater than 1. Every reader goes through it, so such a host gets the browser behaviour: no shell mode, no `ready`, no `routeChanged`, no navigate listener, the PWA manifest kept, and (since #29326 merged) the service worker treated as in a browser.
- **What `ready` means, decided: document it, don't move it.** `ready` means "the Console has painted its own UI", which may be a loading fallback such as `AuthGuard`'s spinner on a cold start to a protected route. The shell lifts its loading cover on `ready`, so the cover hands over to the Console's own spinner; waiting for `AuthGuard` would hold the native cover through a network round-trip. Written on the `ObjectStackNative.ready` member, the `postNativeReady` and `useNativeHostRouting` docblocks, and the README's bridge section. The timing is unchanged and now pinned.
- **README nit.** The `SaveButton` example drops `host ? 'Save' : 'Save changes'` and keeps one label, following the "viewport and capability, not host" rule.

## Tests

- `ui/apps/console/src/__tests__/App.nativeShellOpenSet-29330.test.tsx` (new, the real `App`, `ProtectedRoute` and `AuthGuard` under the real `BrowserRouter`):
  - a `platform: 'desktop'` bridge announcing `haptic` and `openExternal` only: shell mode on, `ready` posted once, `data-os-native-shell="desktop"`, the two announced calls reach the shell and `getPushToken`, `navigate` and `resetServer` resolve `unavailable` and are never called;
  - a cold start to `/` with the session read still open: `ready` arrives while `AuthGuard`'s loading fallback is on screen and before the route renders;
  - a `version: 2` bridge: no root attribute, no `ready`, no route post, calls `unavailable`; control: the same bridge at `version: 1` is the shell.
- `ui/apps/console/src/__tests__/main.nativeBridgeVersion-29330.test.tsx` (new, the real `main.tsx` with its boot calls and its manifest icon step stubbed): a `version: 2` bridge starts the manifest step and the generated manifest replaces the static one; controls: `version: 1` never starts the step and leaves no manifest, no bridge behaves like `version: 2`.
- `ui/packages/mobile/src/__tests__/nativeHost.test.tsx` (extended): a `desktop` bridge is a bridge; `NATIVE_BRIDGE_VERSION` is 1; a newer, string, NaN or missing version is `null` and its calls are `unavailable` and uncalled; versions 1 and 0 are the bridge; `useNativeHostRouting` posts nothing and installs no listener for a version 2 bridge.

## Acceptance notes

- **Reverse checks.** Version gate ablated (the `typeof version` line replaced): 7 cases red across the three files (main version 2, App version 2, four mobile detection cases, mobile routing case), restored byte-identical to HEAD. Old closed union restored on `platform`: `tsc --noEmit` in `ui/apps/console` reds the desktop fixture with TS2322 "Type 'string' is not assignable to type '"ios" | "android"'", restored byte-identical.
- **Widening, not narrowing, for readers.** `git grep` of the bridge symbols across `ui/`, `packages/` and `apps/` finds only `@object-ui/mobile` and the Console; the one reader of `platform` is `NativeShellRouting`, which writes it into an attribute. No exhaustive switch exists to break.
- **Expected red: `check-empty-changeset`.** This PR edits the pending `.changeset/29039-mobile-native-shell-mode.md`, wording only: `data-os-native-shell="ios|android"` becomes the shell's platform string, an open set. That is the gate's deliberate-correction class: the old sentence is false after this PR, so it is corrected here rather than restored, by the card's ruling. The gate stays red by design; it is not one of the required contexts.
- **Surface addition.** The manifest half of the version-gate pin lives where the decision lives, `main.tsx`, so it has its own test file beside the App-level one. No source file outside the card's surface changed; `App.tsx` and `index.ts` are untouched.
- **Merged with `main` after #29326** (service worker), which also edits `ui/packages/mobile/README.md` and `main.tsx`; the merge was clean and the version gate now also covers its worker decision through `getNativeHost()`. A second merge brought #29405, which moved the manifest into an async step after first paint; the manifest test waits for that step and pins whether it starts.

## Verification

All readings at head `28cb3792` (`main` merged at `a6441636`; the 13 `main` commits since touch none of this PR's 8 files).

- Touched suites, from `ui/`: `pnpm exec vitest run` of the two new console files, `App.nativeShellMode-29039.test.tsx`, `packages/mobile/` and `scripts/__tests__/check-vi-mock-inherit.test.ts`: 13 files, 220 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/mobile run type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console run type-check` (both cover the test files): exit 0. `eslint` on the five touched source and test files: exit 0.
- Derived gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` lists 34; all 34 run and reconciled with `--ran` (0 NOT-MEASURED). 33 exit 0, including `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (169 files, 4921 tests) and `check-sdui-manifest`; `check-empty-changeset` exits 1, the expected deliberate-correction red above.
- Changed lines: 524 (+515 / -9) in 8 files, under the 3000-line threshold.
